items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: I enjoyed playing with him. I think he's a real slinging conductor.

ctx.x: Oh, it sounds good. I wonder if that's coming through the tape. I hope so. Yeah. Oh, you go ahead. Some more. After you. Okay. Yes, I did play with Leopold. And, uh, well, that was a long time ago. I'm noble. It took me a long time before I did get to play with Leopold, because, as a matter of fact, I never did play with him until he came to New Orleans here, and he made the famous walkout scene, you know? He came during Mardi Gras season, and you know how the auditorium is divided in two parts. Well, the small…
the beat just the same. What kind of a guy was Massimo Freccia?
